verdict.rationale: Leaving with your data is a fair question for a credential-storing hardware authenticator, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no data-export capability. It documents the opposite: private keys and OATH secrets are generated and kept on the device and 'cannot be exported or extracted'. Community reports describe leaving or replacing a key as manually re-enrolling every account. Use of open standards (OpenPGP, PIV/PKCS#11, FIDO2) reduces lock-in but is an adjacent feature, not an export path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
